incident.what: I wrote an HKLM Image File Execution Options Debugger entry while running without elevation, then discovered I could not remove it from that same session.
incident.effect: Every launch of the client was intercepted by the watchpoint wrapper, so Steam failed with error 84 and the game would not start.
incident.my_error: I changed a machine-wide setting without first securing a way to undo it in the same session.
incident.duration: a few minutes, until the user removed the key from an elevated shell

recovery.evidence: client started through Steam and reached a normal working set

technical_finding.detail: With the HKLM entry present the wrapper was invoked at process creation: the log shows threads_armed 4, plus 2 later threads, and the watch address was Engine.dll base + 0x421428.
technical_finding.detail2: The debugged process exited after 1.1 s with only 56 debug events, which matches the earlier observation that a directly created (debugged) client exits after about 2.4 s.

process_rule_adopted: Any future change outside the workspace must be paired with a verified, same-session rollback path, or it must not be attempted.
